name: Colorado Trail Day 13: Sargents Mesa to Cochetopa Pass
gear: New Balance Hierro v8  Shadow Grey
description: Nice conditions in the morning but then got hit with another snowstorm in the early afternoon for a couple hours. Much lower elevation so not as big of a deal. Eventually petered out into scattered rain showers. Turned the trail into deep slush and slippery mud which made for cold feet. Found one of the better campsites I've had at the end of the day.
